## ♿ Accessibility Checklist

<!-- Please ensure all these checks are completed before submitting your PR -->

- [ ] **Semantic HTML**: Used appropriate elements (e.g., `<button>` for actions, `<a>` for navigation).
- [ ] **ARIA Labels**: Added descriptive labels to icon-only buttons or interactive elements.
- [ ] **Keyboard Navigation**: Ensured all interactive elements are focusable and reachable via Tab key.
- [ ] **Focus States**: Visible focus indicators are present for all interactive elements.
- [ ] **Color Contrast**: Text and icons have sufficient contrast against their background.
- [ ] **Alt Text**: Informative images have descriptive alt text; decorative images use `alt=""` or `aria-hidden="true"`.
- [ ] **Screen Reader Friendly**: Content is structured logically for assistive technology.
